description: This PHP class 'Inspector' provides static methods for asserting various properties of variables and collections, such as type checks, array structure, and object interfaces, primarily used for validation and testing within the Drupal project.

classes.name: Inspector
classes.description: A static class containing methods for asserting properties of variables and collections, used for validation purposes in Drupal.

methods.name: assertAll
methods.description: Checks if all members of a traversable pass a given callable condition.

methods.name: assertAllStrings
methods.description: Checks if all members are strings.

methods.name: assertAllStringable
methods.description: Checks if all members are strings or objects with __toString method.

methods.name: assertStringable
methods.description: Checks if a variable is a string or an object castable to a string.

methods.name: assertAllArrays
methods.description: Checks if all members are arrays.

methods.name: assertStrictArray
methods.description: Checks if an array is a 0-indexed 'strict' array.

methods.name: assertAllStrictArrays
methods.description: Checks if all members are strict arrays.

methods.name: assertAllHaveKey
methods.description: Checks if all members have specified keys.

methods.name: assertAllIntegers
methods.description: Checks if all members are integers.

methods.name: assertAllFloat
methods.description: Checks if all members are floats.

methods.name: assertAllCallable
methods.description: Checks if all members are callable.

methods.name: assertAllNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks if all members are not empty.

methods.name: assertAllNumeric
methods.description: Checks if all members are numeric or castable to numeric.

methods.name: assertAllMatch
methods.description: Checks if all string members contain a specific pattern.

methods.name: assertAllRegularExpressionMatch
methods.description: Checks if all string members match a regex pattern.

methods.name: assertAllObjects
methods.description: Checks if all members are objects, optionally matching specific classes or interfaces.
